principles: People and branch context lead the hierarchy; financial facts are explicitly declared terms, never calculated earnings.
The dashboard uses a deterministic solid brand field so automated contrast proof matches the rendered hierarchy.
Lifecycle mutation is isolated from read detail and names the subject, consequence and typed confirmation.
Audit visibility is a masked HR-domain projection, visually distinct from the Audit account.
Gated profile/access/report/notification entries stay discoverable but inert and dependency-specific.
outcome: accepted for UI-11 implementation evidence; UI-16 retains final cross-account visual-release authority
